description: This file defines the MessageControl class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including nested classes for configuration and observer management, and declares methods for message handling, plugin lifecycle, and WebSocket communication.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main class managing message control, plugin lifecycle, and WebSocket communication within the plugin framework.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container for MessageControl, including network and logging settings.

classes.name: NetworkNode
classes.description: Represents a network node with NodeId, Port, and Binding information.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Handles remote connection notifications and message collection callbacks, managing attachment/detachment of remote clients.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON elements or messages.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Adds a new output publisher to the list.
